researcher_notes: 3 files, all clean official Grenzebach technical-data sheets/brochures (2pp datasheets for FF1200S/L1200S-Li, 5pp brochure for OL1200S). All 3 base models already exist in the DB with every field NULL -- pure enrichment, no new products. Grenzebach's own naming distinguishes vehicle mechanics clearly: L1200S = conventional-drive underride/tunnel AGV (low, tunnels under load carriers), OL1200S = its omnidirectional-drive successor, FF1200S = a lift-type pallet/parts AGV -- all fitting the DB's existing product_type assignments (L1200S/OL1200S = Mobile AMR per the 'underride' keyword convention, FF1200S = Forklift AGV). ADDENDUM (full-batch continuation run, same calendar day): 'Intralogistics_Brochure_EN-2023.pdf' (company-wide, customer case-study format -- König+Neurath, postal/parcel sorting, automotive customers) processed. Confirms 'L1200S' payload range 'between 600 and 1,200 kg' consistent with the existing DB figures, and mentions a Grenzebach 'universal control system' for AGV fleets (proprietary fleet management, already recorded) -- no new fillable per-model fields found beyond what the 3 individual datasheets already provided this batch.

products.notes: This brochure is the richest of the three Grenzebach files and states fleet/integration facts (VDA5050, ERP, Grenzebach Fleet Manager) that likely apply company-wide (same Fleet Manager software mentioned on the FF1200S/L1200S sheets' letterhead area too) -- but since neither sibling sheet explicitly restates these claims itself, they were only written to OL1200S's own fields here rather than assumed for FF1200S/L1200S, to stay strictly source-grounded per product. A dedicated Grenzebach company-wide document, if one exists in a future batch, would be the cleaner way to fan this out formally via the company_wide_context mechanism.
